Ava (product): Heads-up — we have three enterprise customers asking for: longer audit retention (7 years), BYOK with KMS/HSM integration, and SOC2 evidence bundling. Need to align on what we can commit for an MVP.
Diego (eng): Important to call out cost and query SLA tradeoffs. Full 7yr raw event retention with indexing is expensive. We could cap indexed search to 1yr and archive cold blobs for the rest.
Maya (security): From a compliance POV customers expect verifiable chain-of-custody for keys and immutable logs. BYOK designs must include key rotation, key escrow options, and audit trail for key usage.
Sam (sales): Customers will push hard on the 7yr number. If we say "archive accepted but searchable via export in 48h" that's usually fine. They want ability to hand logs to auditors in common formats (JSON/NDJSON/parquet).
Jordan (pm): Proposal for MVP (options):
- Option A (Conservative MVP): 1yr indexed search + 7yr archived blobs (exportable) + BYOK via customer-managed KMS (no HSM initially) + SOC2 evidence bundles for first year only.
- Option B (Premium MVP): 3yr indexed search, 7yr archive, BYOK with optional HSM (partnered), automated evidence packaging for SOC2.
Diego (eng): Implementation notes: indexing cost roughly scales with events * retention. Example config snippet:```
retention_policy {
  indexed_window_days: 365
  archive_window_days: 2555 # ~7yrs
  export_format: "ndjson"
  cold_retrieval_sla_hours: 48
}```
Diego (eng): BYOK integration work: KMS APIs for encrypt/decrypt per-tenant, envelope encryption on storage layer, rotation hooks, and a key-rotation runbook. HSM path adds procurement + partner SDKs.
Maya (security): Must include key-wrapping policy and ensure logs of KMS API calls are captured in our audit stream. Also need threat model for key compromise: revocation, re-wrap data flow, and re-ingestion costs.
Lena (legal): Legal hold/ litigation hold is separate from retention. Customers will ask for hold flags that suspend deletion. Need capability to export holds and produce chain-of-hold evidence. Also data residency constraints for some EU customers.
Ava (product): Asking for a concrete ask: what can eng commit for Q3 launch as Minimum Acceptable? Diego?
Diego (eng): We can commit to Option A with one caveat: cold retrieval SLA is best-effort for Q3; guarantee SLA in Q4 after storage tiering rollout. BYOK: basic KMS integration (AWS KMS/GCP KMS/Azure) for envelope keys in Q3. No HSM initial.
Maya (security): We can support Option A but require automated logging of KMS API calls into immutable audit stream before GA. That is non-negotiable for enterprise contracts.
Sam (sales): If we label Q3 as "BYOK (KMS) + 7yr archive (exportable)" customers will sign. They know HSM is premium; we can price that.
Jordan (pm): Launch criteria draft for Q3 (must meet to ship):
- 1yr indexed, 7yr archive exportable to NDJSON/parquet
- Envelope encryption with customer-managed KMS (AWS/GCP/Azure) implemented and tested
- Audit stream capturing KMS API calls and retention events (immutable)
- Legal hold API to suspend deletion and export hold manifest
- SOC2 evidence bundling for actions in the first year (manual assemble supported)
Diego (eng): Risks: storage cost, search latency for large result sets, complexity of KMS multi-cloud testing. Mitigations: tiered storage, background reindexing, partner KMS test harness.
Maya (security): Also add: key rotation playbook and compromise response runbook must be in docs before GA.
Lena (legal): Need to validate export formats against audit firms; we should sample with 2 customers.
Ava (product): Decision check — can we mark Option A as the Q3 MVP and set HSM and search window increase as Q4? Everyone react with :+1: if OK.
Diego (eng): :+1: (will file tech tasks)
Maya (security): :+1: (will author KMS audit requirements)
Sam (sales): :+1: (will line up pilot customers)
Jordan (pm): :+1: (will update roadmap)
Lena (legal): :+1: (will coordinate with customer legal teams)
audit-bot: New ticket created: #COM-4823 "BYOK + 7yr archive MVP" assigned to eng-team.
Ava (product): Next steps: Diego to post implementation RFC by end of week, Maya to post security checklist, Jordan to update launch criteria doc and coordinate pilot customers. Keep thread for status updates.
Diego (eng): I'll include cost estimates and a minimal storage sizing calc in the RFC. Quick calc example:
- Events/day/customer: 50k
- Avg event size: 2KB -> 100MB/day -> ~36GB/yr/customer indexed + 250GB archived for 7yrs (after compression)
- Note: multi-tenant optimization will reduce unit cost.
Sam (sales): I'll ping the 2 pilot customers (FinCorp, HealthCo) today. They want legal hold + residency check.
Ava (product): Great. Closing the loop — we'll reconvene in 2 weeks to decide final SLA language. Thanks everyone.
